summary: Both editions were independently checked against every clause of the selected Greek. No concrete fidelity defect was identified. Both preserve the unfinished tower, the inspection requirement, the uncut stones, the foundation counts, the conditional promise, and the speakers. Their notes distinguish bracketed readings and the long editorial supplement from preserved witness text, retain the disclosed alternatives, and appropriately limit the internal parallel’s evidential force. Acceptance concerns fidelity to this working source and accurate disclosure of the supplied project reports; it does not authenticate unseen manuscripts or certify an exhaustive collation.
